call.text: The routing module measures the similarity between adjacent encoder outputs by computing cosine similarity of learned query and key projections for each position, forming a boundary probability p_t = ½ (1 − (q_t^⊤ k_{t‑1})/(‖q_t‖‖k_{t‑1}‖)) that lies in [0, 1] [HNET:2.2.1:c023]. A hard boundary indicator b_t is then set to 1 when p_t ≥ 0.5 and 0 otherwise, with p_1 defined as 1.0 to start the sequence with a boundary [HNET:2.2.1:c023]. The module therefore places chunk boundaries at positions where the cosine similarity between consecutive representations drops enough to make p_t ≥ 0.5, reflecting a contextual or semantic shift [HNET:2.2.1:c023].
